intervals.label: selected site for the TRIDENT telescope
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv submission month of the design paper that reports the site selection; the date of the site expedition is not stated in the text read.
intervals.quote: an area near 114.0◦ E, 17.4◦ N was selected as a suitable location to build a large scale deep-sea detector

name: TRIDENT site, north-eastern South China Sea
notes: The facility has no operator and no national jurisdiction in the sources read (country list left empty): the paper gives only the geographic position and the ocean region. Its place is also recorded on the site.

summary.plain: An area of the deep seabed in the north-eastern South China Sea, about 3.5 kilometres down on a flat abyssal plain, chosen after an expedition as the home of the proposed TRIDENT neutrino telescope.
summary.technical: Abyssal plain at a depth of ~3.5 km in the north-eastern South China Sea near 114.0 E, 17.4 N: sea current speed < 10 cm/s below 3 km, absorption length ~27 m and scattering length ~63 m for Cherenkov light (T-REX pathfinder measurements).
